label: Тётя
description: Twelve-mission case drill for тётя (aunt) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The base form тётя is the subject of работает, so it stays in the nominative. Soft feminine nouns in -я keep that ending in the nominative singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. After у the noun shifts to genitive тёти, where the soft ending -я becomes -и. The possessive construction with у triggers the genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The verb подарил takes a dative recipient, turning тётя into тёте with the soft dative ending -е. The dative names the person receiving the gift.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of встретил, тётя takes the accusative тётю; soft feminine nouns change -я to -ю in the accusative singular. In the singular the animate accusative still uses the -ю form.

missions.phrase: Я давно знаком с этой тётей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition с requires the instrumental, so тётя becomes тётей with the soft ending -ей. Stress stays on the stem, so the ending is -ей, not -ёй.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The preposition о takes the prepositional тёте with the soft ending -е, matching the dative form. The phrase о тёте marks the topic of conversation.

missions.phrase: Все мои тёти живут в деревне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the subject of живут, the plural тёти carries the soft nominative ending -и instead of singular -я. Soft feminine nouns mark the nominative plural with -и.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. After нет the noun goes to genitive plural тётей, which takes the soft ending -ей rather than a bare zero ending. This genitive plural form will be reused for the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The recipients of пишу stand in the dative plural тётям, with the ending -ям after the soft stem. The dative names those to whom the letters are written.

missions.phrase: На вокзале я встретил всех тётей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Тётя is animate, so the accusative plural equals the genitive plural тётей rather than the nominative plural тёти. This animate rule applies to all genders in the plural.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition с (here со) governs the instrumental тётями, with the plural ending -ями after the soft stem. The instrumental plural ending is uniform across declensions.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After в the noun takes the prepositional plural тётях, ending in -ях after the soft stem. The prepositional plural ending is the same for all genders.
